MicrosoftAuth._comment: Dev surface: both Guest dev-bypass AND Microsoft OAuth are available. Put ClientId/ApiClientId in this file (local only, do not commit them) or in Key Vault; this repo does not use 'dotnet user-secrets'. When they are present, sign-in completes against your Entra app registration. Until then the Microsoft button is visible but the call returns a friendly 'configure ClientId' message.

AI._comment: Local-dev fallback. In Production these values come from Key Vault (kv-poshared2, PoMiniGames--AI--*). Deployment names verified against the shared account 2026-07-29: gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5.4-mini, Phi-4-mini-instruct, Phi-4. The previous gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4o entries existed on no account and 404'd DeploymentNotFound.
AI.//Deployments: Keys are game keys, optionally suffixed with a task (game.task) to give one job inside a game its own model — see AIFoundryOptions.Tasks. A task with no entry falls back to its game's entry, then to DefaultDeployment, so removing a line here is always safe.

Deployments.//: Both quizzes and similarity scoring run on gpt-5.4-nano, the cheapest model in ModelPricing.cs. Not Phi-4-mini-instruct: it answers 429 RateLimitReached on the first call against this account (measured 2026-08-07).

AI.//EmbeddingDeployment: Empty because the shared account's verified deployment list (2026-07-29) contains no embedding model. Deploy text-embedding-3-small and name it here to move PoCoupleQuiz answer-similarity scoring off chat completions entirely — cheaper by orders of magnitude, deterministic, and permanently cacheable. Nothing else changes; AzureOpenAIQuestionService already prefers it when present.
AI.//ModelCapabilityOverrides: deployment name -> reasoning | conventional | basic. Only needed when a deployment's NAME does not describe what it serves; AiModelCapabilities infers correctly for gpt-5*, gpt-4* and Phi-* without an entry here.
AI.//Provider: azure (Managed Identity against AI Foundry) or openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint plus ApiKey). Empty means infer from FoundryEndpoint: an *.openai.azure.com / *.services.ai.azure.com host is azure, anything else is openai. Set it explicitly only to override that guess.
AI.//ApiKey: Only for Provider=openai. Never set on the azure path: that account has disableLocalAuth and the credential is the Web App's Managed Identity.
AI.//recipes: Ollama (free, local), Gemini and embeddings recipes: DOCS/20261003/architecture_overview.md, 'AI provider recipes'.

TokenBudget.//: Per-identity daily ceiling, now written through to the AiTokenLedger table so an App Service F1 recycle (no AlwaysOn, so idle means recycle) no longer resets every allowance to zero. FlushInterval is the write-behind window: the most spend an ungraceful termination can lose.

QuizPrebake.//: PoFunQuiz question-bank filler. Free: it fills the PoFunQuizBank table from the bundled set and Open Trivia DB, one category at a time. AllowAiTopUp adds paid AI questions and stays false.

Features.//: Development never spends money: canned questions unless you opt in. Set false (and point PoMiniGames:AI at Ollama, see DOCS/20261003/architecture_overview.md) to try real output.
Same as PoFunQuiz: mock questions and scoring in Development unless explicitly overridden.
